name: Difference Browser
summary: A multi-column difference browser over .history/: every historical instance of a tracked file is its own column, oldest left to newest right, with per-column collapse, resize, a changes-only filter, a comparison-base toggle the first filter reveals, and find with F3 and a global mode. Absorbed by axf-claude P5 as contributions to claude-workspace.panel (a summary pane) and claude-workspace.composer-action (quote the newest change); the full grid lives at /diff, where an eight-column layout fits.
